1.text: “Ubwo ibihe bidahishwa Ishoborabyose,Ni iki gituma abayizi batareba iminsi yayo?

3.text: Bahuguza impfubyi indogobe yayo,Batwara inka y'umupfakazi ho ingwate.

4.text: Birukana indushyi mu nzira,Abakene bo mu isi bagakoranira mu rwihisho.

5.text: “Dore bameze nk'imparage zo mu butayu,Bajya ku murimo wabo bakagira umwete wo guhaha,Ubutayu bubamereramo ibyokurya by'abana babo.

6.text: Batema ubwatsi mu mirima yaraye,Kandi bahumba imizabibu y'abanyabyaha.

7.text: Barara bambaye ubusa,Kandi mu mbeho nta cyo bifubika.

8.text: Banyagirwa n'imvura yo mu misozi,Kandi bikinga mu rutare babuze ubwugamo.

9.text: “Hariho abashikuza impfubyi ku ibere,Kandi bagafatīra icyo umukene atunze.

10.text: Bigatuma bagenda bambaye ubusa,Ari nta mwambaro bafite,Kandi bakorerwa imiba bashonje.

11.text: Bagakamurira amavuta mu ngo z'abo bantu,Bakengera mu mivure yabo bafite inyota.

12.text: No mu mudugudu utuwe cyane haba iminiho,Kandi ubugingo bw'inkomere burataka,Ariko Imana ntiyita kuri urwo rugomo.

13.text: “Abo ni abo mu banga umucyo,Ntibazi inzira zawo habe no kugendera muri zo.

14.text: Umwicanyi abyuka mu rukerera,Akica umukene n'indushyi,Kandi nijoro agenza nk'umujura.

15.text: Umusambanyi arindira ko bwira akavuga ati‘Nta wuza kumbona’, akipfuka mu maso.

16.text: Mu mwijima bacukura amazu,Ku manywa bakikingirana,Ntabwo bazi umucyo.

17.text: Bose igitondo kibamerera nk'igicucu cy'urupfu,Kuko bamenyereye ubwoba butewe na cyo.

18.text: “Bahunga bacikiye mu mazi,Umurage wabo ukaba uw'ibivume mu isi,Ntabwo bahinguka mu nzira zijya mu mirima y'inzabibu.

19.text: Icyokere n'ubushyuhe bikamisha amazi ya shelegi,Ni ko ikuzimu hagenza abakoze ibyaha.

20.text: Inda yamubyaye izamwibagirwa,Azaribwa n'inyo aziryohere,Ntazongera kwibukwa ukundi,Gukiranirwa kuzavunwa nk'igiti.

21.text: Anyaga ingumba itigeze kubyara,Kandi ntabwo agirira umupfakazi neza.

22.text: Ariko Imana ikomeza abakomeye n'imbaraga zayo,Ihagurutsa abihebye mu bugingo bwabo.

23.text: Ibaha kugira amahoro bakagubwa neza,Kandi amaso yayo iyahanze ku nzira zabo.

24.text: Bashyirwa hejuru,Hashira igihe gito, bakaba batakiriho.Ni ukuri bacishwa bugufi,Bakavanwa mu nzira nk'abandi bose,Bagatemwa nk'amasaka.

25.text: Niba na n'ubu atari uko biri,Ni nde wahamya ko mbeshya,Agahindura ubusa ibyo mvuze?”
